description: This file defines CMake functions to convert JSON strings into CMake-compatible strings, handling escape sequences and quotes.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a JSON string into a CMake string by removing quotes and processing escape sequences.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a reference to a JSON string into a CMake string by calling json_string_to_cmake with the referenced value.
